$comment: Everything in the repository or the app that is neither a Rust/npm package (SBOM, generated) nor a native binary (native-windows-x64.json) nor an AI download (models.json): fonts, icons, vendored JS, ported code, C libraries compiled in through crates, test fixtures and evidence files. 'paths' are hashed into the SBOM by legal/generate-sbom.mjs. 'shipped' = part of the app (src/ is the frontendDist embedded into VHO.exe; src-tauri/icons go into the bundle). See legal/INVENTORY.md.

items.notes: Inline SVG path strings identical to Google Material Icons (found in R01, present since the baseline commit). Attribution added to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES section 2.9. The other inline SVG icons (simple rectangles/lines) are assumed to be project-authored: owner to confirm.

items.name: VHO application icon / logo
items.author: unconfirmed (present since the baseline commit)
items.notes: Project logo. Not covered by the GPL grant for its use as a name/brand: TRADEMARKS.md governs use of the name and logo (decision 2026-10-25). OPEN ITEM for the owner: confirm who made the logo and that the project holds the rights; if any generator or stock asset was used, record its terms here. Whether the logo files themselves are also offered under GPL-3.0 (copyright) while the mark stays protected (trademark) is an owner/lawyer decision.
